title: The man who sold the Eiffel Tower… twice

scenes.say: In nineteen twenty five, a man SOLD the Eiffel Tower. Like, the actual Eiffel Tower! And the craziest part? He tried it TWICE! Let me explain!
His name was Victor Lustig. He read in the paper that the tower cost a fortune to repair. And he thought... what if I just sell it for scrap?
So he pretended to be a government official, booked a fancy hotel, and invited scrap dealers. Top secret, he said. Don't tell anyone! Which meant nobody checked!
One dealer got nervous. So Lustig asked him for a bribe! And that's what convinced him. Because a real official would totally ask for a bribe, right?
Lustig ran off to Austria with the cash. But the dealer was too embarrassed to tell the police! So Lustig came back... and tried to sell it AGAIN!
Then in America, he even conned Al Capone! Or so the story goes. He borrowed fifty thousand dollars, gave it back, and Capone was so impressed he tipped him! Legend!
But his luck ran out, and he ended up in Alcatraz. The lesson? If a deal is secret, urgent and too good to be true... RUN! Follow for more!
